edges: The economic theory of mutualism is based on the labour theory of value.
Mutualism is closely associated with anarchism, as its principles were set forth by Pierre-Joseph Proudhon.
In a mutualism workplace, workers form an association to create a product or service.
Proponents of mutualism object to capitalism because of the inequalities created by government intervention.
In common with socialism, the economic doctrine of mutualism advocates state control over production.
